about: House of Rain is a local coffee shop whose original drive-thru is at 1439 W Villa Maria Rd in Bryan.
It serves coffee, tea, pastries and weekly drink specials, and has expanded into a sit-down shop in Historic Downtown Bryan.
Customers have given it a perfect 5.0 stars across 81 Google reviews.
